title: Prajna Paramita Retreat 3
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett returns to a passage from Ayya Khema ("On the spiritual path there's nothing to get, and everything to get rid of") and introduces Edward Conze's translations of the Prajnaparamita Sutra in 8,000 lines. Nomon tells of catching a sulky thought about a sangha friend who skipped the retreat, then turning it into an offer of love instead of a fish hook. Conze's life gets a sketch, from a boy reading Diamond Sutra quotations in Lafcadio Hearn to decades of translating, before three groups read Conze beside a contemporary illustrated selection. A closing Ayya Khema passage names a love that arises without any cause, simply because love is the heart's quality.
topics: Soto Zen dharma talk on Ayakima
